_**Agent (composer-2)**_

Here is a concise **repo map** for **El Viajero** (`elviajero-comercio`): a **Next.js 15 App Router** storefront with **Supabase** auth/session, **`content/es.json`** (plus `en.json`, `gn.json`) for a lot of copy, and **dynamic** shop data from APIs/DB.

---

## Stack and global behavior

| Piece | Role |
|--------|------|
| `app/layout.tsx` | Root layout: metadata (SEO, OG), JSON-LD `Store`, `CurrencyProvider`, `ErrorBoundary`. |
| `middleware.ts` | Refreshes Supabase session (`updateSession`). **Login required** for paths under `/mi-cuenta`, `/admin`, `/checkout`. **`/admin` requires `profiles.role === 'admin'`** or redirect to `/mi-cuenta`. |
| `app/sitemap.ts` | Sitemap built from canonical URL + static routes + **`es.json` product names** slugified — note this can drift from live DB slugs if products change only in Supabase. |
| `package.json` | Next 15.5, React 19, Supabase SSR, Tailwind 4, Framer Motion, `better-sqlite3` still listed (often legacy/auxiliary — not the main storefront path if everything is Supabase). |

---

## Public storefront and content pages

These are typical **marketing + catalog** routes (middleware treats many as explicitly “public”; others still work and only run session refresh).

| Route | Purpose (from codebase) |
|--------|---------------------------|
| `/` (`app/page.tsx`) | Home: hero, promos, categories, featured/best sellers, stats, testimonials, newsletter, WhatsApp UX, cart shell — **`content/es.json`** driven in this file. |
| `/tienda` | Catalog UI via `components/pages/tienda-content.tsx` — **`force-dynamic`**. |
| `/productos` | Secondary “products hub” style page (links into store/categories). |
| `/producto/[slug]` | Product detail via `components/pages/product-content.tsx` (wrapped with cart/toast/auth). |
| `/categoria/camping`, `/pesca`, `/accesorios`, `/autos`, `/motos`, `/campo` | Category landing/filter style routes (one segment per slug under `app/categoria/*/page.tsx`). |
| `/nosotros`, `/contacto`, `/faq` | About, contact, FAQ. |
| `/blog`, `/blog/[slug]`, `/blog/categoria/[category]` | Blog listing, post, and category filter. |
| `/promociones` | Promo hub; copy/structure aligns with `"promociones"` in content. |
| `/privacidad`, `/terminos` | Legal pages. |
| `/comparar` | Compare products flow. |

**Feeds / SEO helpers**

| Route | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `app/sitemap.ts` → `/sitemap.xml` | Programmatic sitemap. |
| `app/rss.xml/route.ts` | RSS feed. |

---

## Auth and password recovery

| Route | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `/login`, `/register` | Customer auth screens. |
| `/recuperar` | Recovery request. |
| `/recuperar/[token]` | Reset with token. |
| `app/auth/callback/route.ts` | OAuth / magic-link style callback handling for Supabase. |

---

## Customer account (authenticated)

All under **`/mi-cuenta`** (middleware enforces session).

| Route | Likely purpose (from path names) |
|--------|----------------------------------|
| `/mi-cuenta` | Account dashboard / hub. |
| `/mi-cuenta/pedidos`, `/mi-cuenta/pedidos/detalle` | Order history and order detail. |
| `/mi-cuenta/direcciones` | Saved addresses. |
| `/mi-cuenta/favoritos` | Wishlist / favorites. |
| `/mi-cuenta/beneficios` | Loyalty/benefits content. |
| `/mi-cuenta/configuracion` | Profile/settings. |
| `/mi-cuenta/cancelar` | Cancellation flow (order/subscription — confirm in page). |

---

## Checkout and post-purchase

| Route | Notes |
|--------|--------|
| `/checkout` | **Protected** — must be logged in. |
| `/pedido/confirmado` | Thank-you / confirmation (often usable without admin). |
| `/pedido/buscar` | Order lookup (guest or reference search — behavior in page). |

---

## Newsletter

| Route | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| `/newsletter/unsubscribe` | Unsubscribe UI (not in the short `publicPaths` array, but it is **not** in `protectedPaths`, so it still gets normal session refresh and is not forced to login). |

---

## Admin back office (admin role only)

Base: **`/admin`**. Sub-areas match typical e-commerce ops:

- **`/admin/productos`**, **`/admin/categorias`**, **`/admin/pedidos`**, **`/admin/pedidos/detalle`**
- **`/admin/clientes`**, **`/admin/usuarios`**, **`/admin/suscriptores`**
- **`/admin/promos`**, **`/admin/resenas`**, **`/admin/blog`**
- **`/admin/contenido`**, **`/admin/tema`**, **`/admin/fotos`**
- **`/admin/importar`**, **`/admin/enriquecer`** (data import / enrichment)
- **`/admin/b2b`**, **`/admin/reportes`**

These pair with **`app/api/admin/*`** routes for CRUD and stats.

---

## API surface (high level)

Grouped by concern:

- **Products / catalog:** `app/api/products/route.ts`, `app/api/db/products/route.ts`
- **Orders / checkout:** `app/api/orders/route.ts`, `app/api/checkout/route.ts`, `app/api/db/orders/route.ts`
- **User & profile:** `app/api/update-profile/route.ts`, `app/api/change-password/route.ts`, `app/api/addresses/route.ts`, `app/api/db/users/route.ts`
- **Reviews, promos, shipping:** `app/api/db/reviews/route.ts`, `app/api/db/promos/route.ts`, `app/api/shipping/route.ts`
- **Marketing / lifecycle:** `app/api/subscribe/route.ts`, `app/api/stock-alert/route.ts`, `app/api/cart-recovery/route.ts`, `app/api/lifecycle/route.ts`
- **Auth helper:** `app/api/auth/route.ts`
- **Admin:** many under `app/api/admin/` (products, orders, categories, users, customers, content, blog, promos, reviews, subscribers, B2B, stats)
- **Health:** `app/api/health/route.ts`

---

## Content and i18n

- **`content/es.json`** — primary source for large blocks of UI text and static product/category samples (home imports it directly).
- **`content/en.json`**, **`content/gn.json`** — other locales when the UI switches language.
- **`content/tokens.json`** — shared tokens / copy snippets as used by components.

Runtime catalog may come from **Supabase** (`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_*`); static JSON remains important for fallback, seeds, or sections not yet DB-driven.

---

## Special/error UI

| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `app/not-found.tsx` | 404 UI. |
| `app/error.tsx` | Route error boundary UI. |

---

### Summary

The repo is a **full e-commerce-front**: **marketing site + dynamic store + checkout + Supabase-backed accounts**, an **admin suite**, and a **rich API layer**. Middleware draws a clear line: **only `/mi-cuenta`, `/checkout`, and `/admin` require login**, with **admin routes additionally requiring an admin profile**.

If you want a **deeper page-by-page breakdown** (what each `mi-cuenta` or `admin` screen does in business terms), say which area to zoom into and we can walk file-by-file.

Here is a consolidated **client and brand analysis**, grounded in **`docs/source-of-truth.md`** (owner questionnaire), **`docs/brand-guide.md`**, onboarding and research docs, plus a quick **external check**.

---

## Who the client is

**El Viajero** is a **small Paraguayan retailer** (~**solo operator** per source-of-truth) in **Mariano Roque Alonso** (Coronel Felipe Toledo, La Concordia, near Mariam Lubricantes). They sell **camping → pesca → outdoor personal gear → auto → moto → campo/granja**, in that **volume order** from the owner. **B2C only**; differentiated by **variety, advice/service, delivery speed**.

**Dates and identity:** Owner data says the business started **recently (~2025, “menos de 1 año”)**. Some older internal tables still say **2018** — that is **marked as inaccurate** in source-of-truth and should **not** be reused in public copy until the owner confirms.

**Legal:** Contribuyente general (IVA completo); **domain intention: `tiendaelviajero.com.py`**; **email was expected from the domain**, not necessarily existing at kickoff.

---

## Brand essence and messaging

From the owner questionnaire (**adventure / naturaleza / aire libre**, tone **aventurero / inspirador**, visual **rústico–natural**, colors **green + blue water/sky + black/graphite**).

The **implemented site** follows **`docs/brand-guide.md`**: **forest green `#1B5E20`**, **grey secondary**, **orange accent `#E65100`**, **Inter**, pragmatic friendly voice. **Tagline:** *“Tu Aventura Empieza Acá.”* Owner had **no final slogan locked** yet — treat tagline as **approved working line** unless they replace it.

**Logo:** Owner started **without a logo**; the project generated one for review (`client-onboarding.md` references the SVG on the staging site).

---

## Offer, customers, competitors

**~50–200 SKUs**, many with photos; **fixed prices**, wide **ticket (₲50k–150k up to ₲1M+)**; **import + nacional + regional**.

**Buyer mix:** Broad ages, families, tourists/foreigners.

**Named competitors:** **El Mohicano**, **Shark Black**. **Market research** in `docs/competition-dossier.md` / `docs/research.md` maps **40+ Paraguayan players** (Camping44, PescaPro, TUPI/Lincoln tactical/camping aisles, etc.)—useful for **positioning**, not as facts **about** El Viajero.

---

## Operations snapshot

**Hours:** Open **seven days**, **without siesta**; **exact clocks TBD**.  
**Delivery:** Urban + **encomiendas** nationwide, **tiered/fixed** by distance.  
**Payments today:** Cash (Gs/USD), transfer/deposit, in-person cards, **Tigo Money**; **want** gateway + logged-in shoppers **plus WhatsApp**.

**Promotions:** Owner wants **old vs new price**, **seasonal offers**, **gift combos**.

---

## External research

Targeted web search **did not** find an independent listing clearly tied to **this** “El Viajero” at the documented address. **Do not infer** legitimacy or details from SERPs alone; **`source-of-truth.md` + direct client confirmation** stay authoritative.

---

## Documentation artifact

A **single consolidated reference** is now in:

**[`docs/client-profile.md`](docs/client-profile.md)**

It summarizes identity, catalogue, positioning, brand (including **where owner preferences differ from shipped green/orange**), payments/delivery, product requirements vs repo features, competitor landscape, and an **alignment checklist** (WhatsApp/social contradictions between `brand-guide` and questionnaire, founding year, hours, imagery, domain).

**Cross-references you already had:** [`docs/source-of-truth.md`](docs/source-of-truth.md), [`docs/brand-guide.md`](docs/brand-guide.md), [`docs/client-onboarding.md`](docs/client-onboarding.md), [`docs/research.md`](docs/research.md), [`docs/competition-dossier.md`](docs/competition-dossier.md).

If you want the next step, it would be **one pass to normalize** conflicting strings in `content/es.json`, layout JSON-LD, and `brand-guide.md` once the owner sends **canonical WhatsApp, socials, and hours**.

## Page inventory — visuals

| Route | What drives visuals | Priority assets |
|--------|---------------------|----------------|
| **`/`** | `HeroCarousel` (`home.heroCarousel.slides[].image`), product `imageUrl` rails, categories (letter placeholders), testimonials (no photos), payments (SVG brands), Maps iframe | **Landscape hero photos**, real **SKU** shots, optional **category icons**, optional storefront photo |
| **`/tienda`** | `TiendaContent` + API/`imageUrl`; `CategoryContent` uses `/images/categories/{slug}.svg` as faded BG | **Product photography** per item; stronger **category** art |
| **`/producto/[slug]`** | Gallery + related products | **Multi-angle SKU** sets (real photos ideal) |
| **`/productos`** | Gradient cards + first letter **only** | **7 category hero images** (biggest UX gap after products) |
| **`/categoria/*`** | Same as tienda category layout + SVG BG | Align with `/productos` heroes for consistency |
| **`/comparar`** | Thumbnails from catalog | Same as product images |
| **`/checkout`** / auth | Minimal UI | Optional side **lifestyle** panel |
| **`/nosotros`** | Placeholder “owner photo” SVG | **Real portrait** of owner (high trust) |
| **`/contacto`** | Plain hero band | Optional **storefront/interior** |
| **`/faq`, `/privacidad`, `/terminos`** | Text heroes | Optional light icon set only |
| **`/blog`**, **`/blog/[slug]`**, **`/blog/categoria/...`** | Unsplash URLs in `content/es.json` | **Owned 16∶9** art per category + post |
| **`/promociones`** | Unsplash on promo cards | **Bundle-themed** images (generic gear) |
| **`/mi-cuenta/*`** | Order/favoritos thumbs | Real `imageUrl` from data |
| **Admin** | `image_url` grid | Same as catalog |

**Already in `public/images`:** `logo.svg`, `favicon.svg`, `og-viajero.svg`, `hero-bg.svg`, root + `categories/*.svg`, **30+ flat `productos/*.svg` illustrations**.

**External:** Many **Unsplash** URLs for blog + promos.

**Broken / missing vs manifest:** `manifest.json` expects **`icon-192.png`** and **`icon-512.png`** — **there are zero PNGs in `public/`**; add exported icons.

## What you actually need (priority order)

1. **Real photos** for every SKU you sell (or supplier shots you’re allowed to use) — PDP, cart, search, emails.  
2. **Marketing heroes** replacing SVG/Unsplash on home carousel and weak pages (`/productos`).  
3. **Blog/promo** owned images — licensing and CDN control.  
4. **Logo-derived PWA PNGs.**  
5. **`/nosotros` owner photo** (camera, not AI).

AI generation fits **lifestyles, bundles, ambient category art** — not deceptive stand-ins for **specific branded inventory**.

## Full explanatory prompt for generating images

Everything is spelled out **section by section** (specs, ethics, **Master brief**, **Pack A–F**, **negative prompts**, implementation checklist) in:

[`docs/visual-assets-inventory-and-image-generation-prompt.md`](docs/visual-assets-inventory-and-image-generation-prompt.md)

**How to use it:** Paste **§6 Master brief + negative prompts** as your global system/context, then generate **Pack A**, **Pack B**, etc., as separate batches (each pack lists aspect ratios and subjects).

Below is the **global brief + negatives** block you can prepend to every generation (pack details stay in the doc).

```markdown
MASTER BRIEF — "El Viajero" outdoor retail — Paraguay

Brand: Practical adventure; trustworthy local shop (not luxury, not tactical-military ads).

Colors: Deep forest green #1B5E20; warm orange #E65100 only as small accents; off-white #FAFAFA / white surfaces; slate #37474F in shadows acceptable.

Style: Commercial lifestyle + clean product aesthetic. Natural warm grading; crisp focus. No HDR excess, no cyberpunk, no cartoon (except separate icon commissions).

Lighting: Golden hour outdoors OR bright soft daylight; product shots use large softbox even light.

Composition: Negative space for possible Spanish headline overlay (subject in centre or lower third).

People: Diverse adults/families in outdoor clothing; authentic emotions; no readable fake logos on clothes.

Gear: UNBRANDED realistic tents, rods, coolers, helmets, tools. Do not mimic real trademarks.

Environments: Subtropical river, trails, savanna/red earth, approachable small-shop shelves — credible for Paraguayan outdoor retail without falsely naming protected sites.

Technical: sRGB; no watermark; NO text inside image (UI adds copy); heroes 1920×1080 16:9 or as specified per pack; products 2048×2048 on white/light grey unless specified.

NEGATIVE PROMPTS (always append): blurry, low-res, watermark, logo text, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed tent poles, fisheye, grimdark military, snakes as focal subject, intoxication, weapons beyond camping tools/legal knives, counterfeit packaging, recognizable car/luxury badges, readable payment card data.

Generate next following PACK [A/B/C/D/E/F] from docs/visual-assets-inventory-and-image-generation-prompt.md with exact crops listed there.
```

If you want **one single chat message** tailored to Midjourney v6, Flux, or DALL-E 3 (with syntax quirks), say which tool and typical aspect-ratio flags—I can adapt §6–7 into ready-to-send lines without editing more repo files unless you ask.
